news.title: A Metro Atlanta woman missing $500 in checks, blames no lock on USPS collection box
news.summary: The resident, who asked not to be identified, said she dropped four separate checks into a collection box at the post office and later learned the payments never reached their intended recipients.

news.title: Car break-ins led Smyrna police to a wanted murder suspect
news.summary: Smyrna police captured 19-year-old Trey Webb last Thursday while responding to a report of car break-ins on Spring Road.

news.title: DNA testing solves 1997 missing woman case in Conyers
news.summary: The Conyers Police Department has positively identified human remains found in 2016 as Tammy Fortson, a woman who went missing nearly three decades ago.

news.title: Skeletal remains found in Conyers in 2016 identified as woman who went missing in 1997, police say
news.summary: The Conyers Police Department said Tammy Forston was positively identified by the GBI medical examiner in July of this year.

news.title: Bodycam shows 4 women arrested on I-85 after Newnan Target theft
news.summary: Four Alabama women face felony shoplifting charges after police said they stole $1,800 in merchandise from a Newnan Target.

news.title: 1 dead, 4 injured in Goliath ride incident at Six Flags Over Georgia
news.summary: Officials confirmed to Channel 2 Cobb County Bureau Chief Michele Newell that one park visitor has died. Four others were injured.

news.title: 7-month-old killed in DeKalb County 10-car crash following police chase
news.summary: High-speed police chase on Interstate 20 in DeKalb County ends in a 10-car crash at Wesley Chapel Road.

news.title: DA decides whether to press charges after school bus stop fight led to 12-year-old’s death
news.summary: A school bus fight led to the death of a 12-year-old. On Monday, the Douglas County District Attorney’s Office announced whether charges would be filed.

news.title: Man found shot to death inside burned Atlanta apartment
news.summary: A convicted felon who received a 25-year sentence as part of a negotiated plea deal is now accused of killing a 22-year-old Atlanta man and opening fire on three other people just one day earlier.

news.title: Man found dead outside Tucker apartment building after reports of gunfire, police say
news.summary: Gwinnett County police are investigating after a man was found dead outside a Tucker apartment building following reports of gunfire.

news.title: Douglas County DA: No charges in death of 12-year-old Jada West
news.summary: The Douglas County District Attorney’s Office will not file criminal charges in the death of 12-year-old Jada West, who passed away following a brief fight after getting off her school bus in Villa Ri

news.title: Young man shot to death inside vehicle in DeKalb County
news.summary: DeKalb County police responded to a report of a shooting around 11:06 p.m. Sunday.

news.title: Woman in jail after hitting 3 people with her vehicle in Decatur, police say
news.summary: An investigation led detectives to believe that the suspect intentionally drove into the victims following a fight inside the establishment.
